test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Around which fort did the city of Chennai develop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fort Saint George**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fort Saint George** is historically recognized as the first **English fortress** in **India**, founded in **1644** in the coastal city of **Madras**, which is now known as **Chennai**.
 
• The construction of the fort was initiated by the **British East India Company** through its agents, **Francis Day** and **Andrew Cogan**, who secured the grant of land from the local **Nayaka** rulers in **1639**.
 
• The city of **Chennai** effectively developed and expanded around this fort, which served as a nucleus for **British** administrative and commercial activities in **South India** for centuries.
 
• Historically, the settlement within the fort walls was referred to as **White Town**, while the indigenous settlements that grew outside the walls were known as **Black Town** (later renamed **George Town**).
 
• Today, the fort continues to be a vital administrative hub, housing the **Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly** and the **Secretariat** of the **Government of Tamil Nadu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mehrangarh Fort**:

 
 
• It is located in **Jodhpur**, **Rajasthan**, and is one of the largest and most magnificent forts in **India**.
 
• Built around **1459** by **Rao Jodha**, the founder of **Jodhpur**, it sits on a perpendicular cliff, **410 feet** above the skyline of the city.
 
 
 
• **Fort William**:
 
 
• This fort is located in **Kolkata** (formerly **Calcutta**), **West Bengal**, on the eastern banks of the **Hooghly River**.
 
• Named after **King William III**, the current structure was completed in **1781** following the **British** victory in the **Battle of Plassey** to prevent future attacks from **Bengal Nawabs**.
 
 
 
• **Sindhudurg Fort**:
 
 
• Located on the shore of **Malvan** in the **Konkan** region of **Maharashtra**, it is a powerful **sea fort**.
 
• It was built by **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj** in **1664** to counter the rising influence of foreign colonial powers like the **English**, **Dutch**, and **Portuguese** and to defend the **Maratha Empire**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **St. Mary's Church**: Located inside **Fort Saint George**, it is the oldest **Anglican church** in **India**, consecrated in **1680**.
 
• **Fort Museum**: The fort houses a museum that exhibits a large repository of weapons, uniforms, and artifacts from the **British** period, including the **first Indian Tricolour** hoisted at the fort after **Independence** on **August 15, 1947**.
 
• **Geographical Context**: The city of **Chennai** is situated on the **Coromandel Coast** of the **Bay of Bengal**. It was renamed from **Madras** in the year **1996** by the state government.
 
• **Architecture**: The fort walls were designed to withstand heavy **cannon fire**, reflecting the **military architecture** of the **17th century**.
